sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that she could not get instructions from the appellant inspite of her best efforts.
The appeal is of the year 2012.
I do not find any reason to adjourn the matter.
It seems that the appellant is not interested in prosecuting the appeal.

Hence, the appeal is dismissed for default, i.e.,
for non-prosecution.
SD/-
